lines.say: Why do toy bricks stick? There's no glue.
The stud is slightly too big for the gap.
So the plastic bends, and squeezes back.
The molds are accurate to a hundredth of a millimetre.
lines.caption: 0.01 MM

lines.say: It starts as plastic grains, melted at about two hundred thirty degrees Celsius.
lines.caption: 230 °C

lines.say: Injected into a steel mold, with up to a hundred and fifty tons of pressure.
lines.caption: UP TO 150 TONS

lines.say: About seven seconds later, a brick drops out.
lines.caption: ABOUT 7 SECONDS

lines.say: Press two together. Squeeze, not glue.
Gummy bear, or ballpoint pen? Comment below.
